criteria.text: Diagnosis of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group I). Approval criteria 1 and 2 describe the same diagnosis.
Not currently treated with or taking any nitrate products. Denial if the patient is on any nitrate product.
Tried generic sildenafil OR documented allergy or hypersensitivity to a component of all available generic sildenafil.

notes: Partial encoding from AK Adcirca (tadalafil), a phosphodiesterase 5 (PDE5) inhibitor for PAH, Criteria Version 2 (Updated/Approved 09/19/2014). The existing ingest effective_date 2023-06-01 is retained; the PDF version date is distinct.

Encoded: closed PAH (WHO Group I) indication covering approval criteria 1–2; no current nitrate products (approval criterion 3 and denial criterion); generic sildenafil trial OR documented allergy/hypersensitivity to a component of all available generic sildenafil (criteria 4–5). The exception does not bypass the diagnosis or nitrate requirements.

The PDF states no numeric age gate; no age criterion is encoded. Sildenafil trial and documented allergy/hypersensitivity are selected attestations; no trial duration or failure requirement is specified.
Duration notes only: approval may be granted up to 1 year. Quantity limit: 2 tablets/day, attestation/manual review only, not a numeric predicate.

PDL: Adcirca (tadalafil) is non-preferred in PAH AGENTS, ORAL AND INHALED; generic sildenafil is a preferred peer. Revatio remains text_only. No evaluate()-linked PAH peer pack is available, so alternatives is empty; class/PDL alternatives remain available through the UI.
